event.description:
https://boneio.eu/docs/black/configuration/event 
 GPIO event entity section of boneIO Black. It enables event entities in HA. It detects single, double and long click. It can run action based on states. It always send message to MQTT broker of invoked state.

id.description: Id to use for MQTT topic. Default to boneio_input or pin number.
id.title: Id

bounce_time.description: Bounce time for GPIO in miliseconds. Only for advanced usage.
bounce_time.title: Bounce time

area.markdownDescription:
Area/Room

Reference to area ID defined in 'areas' section.
Creates a sub-device linked to the main BoneIO device.
area.title: Area

show_in_ha.description: If you want you can disable discovering this input in HA.
show_in_ha.title: Show in ha

inverted.description: Check if sensor type is inverted. Only aplicable for sensor kind.
inverted.title: Inverted

device_class.description: Device class to use in HA
device_class.title: Device class

double_click_duration.markdownDescription:
Double Click Duration

Time window in milliseconds to detect double click.
If second click happens within this time, it's detected as double click.
double_click_duration.title: Double click duration

long_press_duration.markdownDescription:
Long Press Duration

Time in milliseconds to detect long press.
If button is held longer than this, it's detected as long press.
long_press_duration.title: Long press duration

sequence_window_duration.markdownDescription:
Sequence Window Duration

Time window in milliseconds to detect click sequences.
If next click happens within this time after previous, it's detected as sequence (e.g., double_then_long).
sequence_window_duration.title: Sequence window duration

sequence_mode.markdownDescription:
Sequence Mode

How to handle click sequences:
- immediate: Base events (single, double, long) fire immediately. Sequences are additional events.
- exclusive: Base events are delayed by sequence_window. If sequence is detected, only sequence fires (no base events).
sequence_mode.title: Sequence mode

enable_triple_click.markdownDescription:
Enable Triple Click

Enable triple click detection. Disabled by default to avoid conflicts with double_then sequence.
enable_triple_click.title: Enable triple click

long_press_mqtt_mode.markdownDescription:
Long Press MQTT Mode

How long press events are published to MQTT:
- single: Only the first long press event is sent. Periodic updates are skipped. Prevents repeated triggers in Node-RED.
- periodic: All long press events (with growing duration) are sent every 200ms. Use if you need duration tracking in MQTT.
long_press_mqtt_mode.title: Long press mqtt mode

max_long_press_duration.markdownDescription:
Max Long Press Duration

Safety timeout for long press (hard max: 30s).
If a long press exceeds this duration, it is automatically stopped.
Prevents infinite long press events when RELEASE edge is missed (e.g., due to EMI or hardware issues).
Values above 30s are clamped to 30s.
max_long_press_duration.title: Max long press duration

mqtt_sequences.markdownDescription:
MQTT Sequences

Which click sequences should be published to MQTT
mqtt_sequences.title: Mqtt sequences

event.title: Event

position.description: Position to set cover to for SET_POSITION. 0 means closed, 100 means opened.
position.title: Position

tilt_position.description: Tilt position to set cover to. 0 means closed, 100 means opened.
tilt_position.title: Tilt position

always_open_till.markdownDescription:
Smart toggle threshold (0-100%).

Position threshold for SMART_TOGGLE action.
If cover position is at or below this value, it will always open.
Above this value, normal toggle behavior applies.
always_open_till.title: Always open till

type.markdownDescription:
Condition type

Type of condition to check before executing the action.
- time: Check if current time is within a range (e.g. 05:00-22:00)
- date: Check if current date is within a range (e.g. 11-01 to 03-31)
- state: Check if a boneIO entity is in a specific state
- sun: Check the position of the Sun (needs the `location:` section)
type.title: Type

after.markdownDescription:
After (start of range)

For time: "HH:MM" format (e.g. "05:00", "22:30")
For date: "MM-DD" format (e.g. "11-01" for November 1st)
For sun: a sun anchor, e.g. "sunrise", "civil_dusk", "solar_noon"
after.title: After

before.markdownDescription:
Before (end of range)

For time: "HH:MM" format (e.g. "22:00", "06:00")
For date: "MM-DD" format (e.g. "03-31" for March 31st)
For sun: a sun anchor, e.g. "sunset", "civil_dawn"
before.title: Before

after_offset.markdownDescription:
Offset from the 'after' anchor (sun only)

Shifts the start of the window. Negative is earlier:
after: sunset with after_offset: "-15min" starts a quarter of an hour
before sunset. Accepts s, min and h; a bare number means seconds.
Limited to ±12 h — a larger offset is no longer a reference to that
anchor, and `type: time` says it more clearly.
after_offset.title: After offset

before_offset.markdownDescription:
Offset from the 'before' anchor (sun only)

Shifts the end of the window. Same format as after_offset.
before_offset.title: Before offset

phase.markdownDescription:
Sun phase (sun only)

True while the Sun is in this phase.
- day: above the horizon
- civil_twilight / nautical_twilight / astronomical_twilight: -6/-12/-18°
- night: more than 18° below the horizon
- golden_hour: -4° to +6°, blue_hour: -6° to -4°
Golden and blue hour overlap the others — they are photographic bands,
not separate parts of the day.
phase.title: Phase

above.markdownDescription:
Sun elevation above (degrees, sun only)

True while the Sun is higher than this many degrees above the horizon.
Negative values are below it. Combine with `below` for a band.
above.title: Above

below.markdownDescription:
Sun elevation below (degrees, sun only)

True while the Sun is lower than this many degrees above the horizon.
below.title: Below

entity.markdownDescription:
Entity type (for state condition)

Type of boneIO entity to check state of.
Includes virtual switches (flags with no hardware behind them) and
remote entities (outputs/covers/inputs from ESPHome/CAN devices).
entity.title: Entity

entity_id.markdownDescription:
Entity ID (for state condition)

ID of the boneIO entity to check state of.
entity_id.title: Entity id

state.markdownDescription:
Expected state (for state condition)

Expected state of the entity.
- binary_sensor/remote_input: is_on, is_off
- cover: is_open, is_closed
- output/light/virtual_switch: is_on, is_off
state.title: State

mode.markdownDescription:
Condition mode

How to combine multiple conditions:
- and: ALL conditions must be true (default)
- or: ANY condition must be true
mode.title: Mode

list.markdownDescription:
List of conditions

List of conditions to evaluate. Combined using the mode (and/or).
list.title: List

boneio_output.markdownDescription:
Output ID

ID of the output to control. This should match the id/boneio_output defined in your output configuration.
boneio_output.title: Boneio output

boneio_cover.markdownDescription:
Cover ID

ID of the cover to control. This should match the id defined in your cover configuration.
boneio_cover.title: Boneio cover

boneio_virtual_switch.markdownDescription:
Virtual switch ID

ID of the virtual switch to set. Matches an entry in the
`virtual_switch:` section — a flag with no relay behind it, which
conditions can then read. See docs/VIRTUAL_SWITCHES.md.
boneio_virtual_switch.title: Boneio virtual switch

action_cover.description: If cover action chosen then what action to perform.
action_cover.title: Action cover

data.description: Extra data for cover actions (position, tilt, smart toggle threshold).
data.title: Data

restore_tilt.markdownDescription:
Restore Tilt After Movement

When true, the previous tilt angle is saved before executing this cover action
and restored after the movement finishes. Only applies to venetian covers.
Example: pressing a button to close the blinds to 50% and then restoring
the slat angle to the previous value.
restore_tilt.title: Restore tilt

brightness.markdownDescription:
Brightness (0-255)

Brightness level for SET_BRIGHTNESS action or initial brightness for ON action.
Only used for ESPHome light entities. 0 = off, 255 = full brightness.
brightness.title: Brightness

brightness_step.markdownDescription:
Brightness step (1-50%)

Step size (in percent) for BRIGHTNESS_UP, BRIGHTNESS_DOWN, BRIGHTNESS_UP_CYCLE 
and BRIGHTNESS_DOWN_CYCLE actions. Default is 10.
brightness_step.title: Brightness step

color_temp.markdownDescription:
Color Temperature (mireds)

Color temperature in mireds. Only for ESPHome lights with color temperature support.
Lower values = cooler (bluer), higher values = warmer (yellower).
Typical range: 153 (6500K cool) to 500 (2000K warm).
color_temp.title: Color temp

rgb.markdownDescription:
RGB Color [R, G, B]

RGB color as list [red, green, blue], each value 0-255.
Only for ESPHome lights with RGB support.
Example: [255, 0, 0] for red, [0, 255, 0] for green, [0, 0, 255] for blue.
rgb.title: Rgb

colors.markdownDescription:
Color List for CYCLE_COLOR

List of RGB colors to cycle through on each press.
Each color is a list of [R, G, B] values (0-255).
Only used when action_output is CYCLE_COLOR.
Example: [[255, 0, 0], [0, 255, 0], [0, 0, 255]]
colors.title: Colors

presets.markdownDescription:
Preset/Effect List for CYCLE_PRESET

List of effect names (ESPHome) or effect IDs (WLED) to cycle through on each press.
For ESPHome: list of effect name strings, e.g. ["Rainbow", "Strobe", "Color Wipe"]
For WLED: list of effect IDs (integers), e.g. [0, 9, 47]
Only used when action_output is CYCLE_PRESET.
presets.title: Presets

repeat.markdownDescription:
Repeat on Hold

When true, this action will be executed repeatedly while the button is held (long press).
Only effective for actions under the 'long' click type.
Example: brightness_up with repeat will increase brightness continuously while holding.
repeat.title: Repeat

repeat_interval.markdownDescription:
Repeat Interval

Minimum interval between repeated executions.
Only used when repeat is true. Default: 800ms.
Minimum: 200ms (matches periodic event interval).
repeat_interval.title: Repeat interval

probability.markdownDescription:
Chance of running

Run this action only some of the time. 1 (the default) always, 0.7
seven times out of ten, 0 never.

For presence simulation. `jitter` on a schedule randomises *when* a
step happens; this randomises *whether* it happens at all, which is
the difference between lights on a timer and somebody living there —
three evenings of the same four steps is a pattern an observer can
read.

Drawn per firing, after the conditions: a `probability` of 0.5 on an
action whose condition is false still never runs.
probability.title: Probability

delay.markdownDescription:
Delay Before Execution

Wait this amount of time before executing the action.
If the same input triggers a cancel event (see delay_cancel_on)
during the wait, the action is cancelled.
Useful for motion sensors: turn OFF after 2 minutes of no motion,
but cancel if motion is re-detected.
Example: 30s, 2min, 1h
delay.title: Delay

delay_cancel_on.markdownDescription:
Cancel Delay On Events

List of input events that cancel the pending delayed action.
When any of these events occur on the same input, the delayed
action timer is cancelled and the action is not executed.
Example: ['pressed'] — cancel OFF delay when motion re-detected.
delay_cancel_on.title: Delay cancel on

Output ID

ID of the output to control. This should match the id/boneio_output defined in your output configuration.
boneio_output.title: Boneio output

action_output.markdownDescription:
If output action chosen then what action to perform.

Reused by the virtual_switch action, which takes the same three verbs:
ON, OFF and TOGGLE. One concept, not two near-identical fields.

For ESPHome lights, additional actions are available:
- BRIGHTNESS_UP: Increase brightness by 10% (turns on at 10% if OFF)
- BRIGHTNESS_DOWN: Decrease brightness by 10% (turns off at 10%)
- BRIGHTNESS_UP_CYCLE: Like BRIGHTNESS_UP but wraps from 100% to 10%
- BRIGHTNESS_DOWN_CYCLE: Like BRIGHTNESS_DOWN but wraps from 10% to 100%
- SET_BRIGHTNESS: Set specific brightness (requires brightness field)
- CYCLE_COLOR: Cycle through a list of RGB colors on each press (requires colors field)
- CYCLE_PRESET: Cycle through a list of effects/presets on each press (requires presets field)
action_output.title: Action output

- BRIGHTNESS_DOWN_CYCLE: Like BRIGHTNESS_DOWN but wraps from 10% to 100%

- CYCLE_COLOR: Cycle through a list of RGB colors on each press (requires colors field)

probability.markdownDescription:

Run this action only some of the time. 1 (the default) always, 0.7

three evenings of the same four steps is a pattern an observer can
read.

action whose condition is false still never runs.
